fixed.item: finish_breakages.json (pets): the dog bolts through the 10 % an unlatched door swings on a pull_handle / push_handle test (mech.open_frac 0.1); mechanisms alone needs 30 %
fixed.how: Decided and pinned: a pet dashes, crosses (wants in/out) or slips in (stray) only through an opening it fits through, the gap the pets' own moves already used. common.door_opening (open_frac; a plain open door 1.0) and common.door_gap (cat 12 %, any other animal 25 %) are one helper shared with conn_open. behavior._door_opened skips a pet when the opening is narrower than its gap or was already wide enough before the step (behavior's before hooks on pull_handle / push_handle record pets_door_was_frac instead of a was-open flag; _door_pulled_open / _door_pushed_open call _door_opened whenever the opening grew). So the test crack lets no pet out, now or later; pulling the cracked door open is the step the dog bolts on (at HEAD the crack counted as open and widening it never dashed); widening a door already wide enough is no new opening, as at HEAD. Why not 30 %: pets owns escapes while loaded, and a 30 % dash next to a 25 % passage would let a dog walk through an opening it refused to dash through; mechanisms alone keeps its 30 %.
